task_title: Reduce PR automation and CI setup overhead

plan_review.notes: Adjusted the plan after review: kept global PR-guard concurrency while scoping event runs to the triggering PR only; included .github/actions/setup-node/action.yml and tsconfig*.json in Epic Drift inputs; kept the Human approval job untouched to preserve the rerun workflow contract; and folded only advisory/non-blocking coverage + build work into ci-advisory while consolidating the two lightweight static CI jobs. The required issue-plan comment was prepared, but the environment lacks a working issue-comment write path (gh remote is localhost and direct GitHub API calls are blocked), so that blocker will be reported explicitly.
